purpose: Development repair of the same two previously observed pilot tasks; not an independent held-out evaluation
environment: official 1000-product text preview and original human goals
selection: Unchanged from run_20261009; no task replacement
changes: General evidence-first actor instruction: every function/feature, variant and price must be grounded in visible product evidence before purchase
Budget 20 -> 40 steps to allow candidate comparison; no changes to environment, catalog, goals, transitions or rewards
actor_inputs: Fixed general policy plus exact visible observations/action availability and observed history. No goal metadata, scorer breakdown, target IDs or reference solution. Separate empty-cwd no-tools model calls.
retry_policy: Append-only numbered attempts; all low-reward and runtime failures retained. Development set retries are explicit. Success gate requires a complete single attempt with both original tasks reward=1 and done=true.
self_evolution: Human/Codex engineered actor-policy repair; not autonomous self-evolution or a generalization claim
